rows.label: tlk70000054_03_msg0002
rows.name:
By the way, the people you brought us
have been doing very well since then.

rows.label: tlk70000054_03_msg0003
rows.name:
Former adventurer Isabella is ready to
fight, and volunteer Luc seems to have
promise too.

rows.label: tlk70000054_03_msg0005
rows.name:
Together, the four of them just
about make one competent recruit.

rows.label: tlk70000054_03_msg0006
rows.name:
But while they keep at it
and don't run away, I'll
look after them myself.
